items.project: The Foundry (Lennar) - former Cashman Center / Grant Sawyer sites
items.status: Ceremonial groundbreaking mid-Oct 2026; Grant Sawyer demolition began July 2026; vertical construction follows demolition and end of Las Vegas Lights FC 2026 season at Cashman Field
items.summary: 1,000+ single-family homes and townhomes in six collections, starting in the $300,000s, on ~70 acres.
items.whyItMatters: Largest downtown for-sale housing build in years; changes the Cashman District and downtown housing supply at entry-level prices.
items.recommendedAngle: What's being built at Cashman and what it means for downtown housing; 'How this area is changing'.
verifiedFacts: Lennar selected via competitive process; Gov. Lombardo and Mayor Berkley attended groundbreaking (search summaries of Fox5/News 3)
